g.text: Single-shot revolver SFX for a 1930s navy officer's sidearm in a
top-down survival game. Dry crack with mid-forward punch, short
metallic cylinder-spin tail, subtle low thump; slightly wet with
harbor reverb (small room, stone walls). Must remain crisp when
fired 6-8 times per second in bursts. No sci-fi layers, no modern
suppressor character. Deliver 48 kHz WAV, 0.8-1.2 s, plus a quieter
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
